GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   C. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

8. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   D. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

12. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

14. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   D. Treat Industry as rumours only.

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
